pages.title: Psychiatry consult
pages.text:
## PSYCHIATRY CONSULTATION
Date: 09/04/2026 10:30
Reason: agitation, aggression toward staff 09/03, hx schizophrenia off meds
## Interview
Pt guarded, intermittently responding to internal stimuli. Endorses auditory hallucinations x weeks: male voices that "tell me to hurt people who are trying to poison me", including staff. Reports he sometimes "has to listen." Denies SI. Denies plan to harm specific person "right now." Poor insight.
MSE: disheveled, psychomotor restless, speech pressured, mood "annoyed", affect irritable, thought process tangential, + paranoid delusions, + command AH, cognition grossly intact, AOx4. Judgment/insight poor.
## Assessment
Schizophrenia, acute exacerbation in setting of medication nonadherence and methamphetamine use. Command auditory hallucinations to harm others. Aggression toward staff 09/03 and 09/04.
## Recommendations
- Restart risperidone 1 mg PO BID, titrate to 2 mg BID
- Olanzapine 5 mg IM/PO q6h PRN severe agitation
- Continue 1:1 sitter
- 5150 evaluation: does not meet criteria at this exact time; reassess daily; low threshold
- Recommend psychiatric stabilization before discharge to any congregate setting
Signed: G. Iqbal, MD (Psychiatry)
